g.text: The One With the Floor Plan
the balcony has no floor area
1 m out of line, on purpose
one wall: kitchen run, then bath
Fan art: an original drawing of a fictional set's layout as documented by fans; no marks or
character names appear. 1 — the balcony is a railing, so Apartment 20's 108.00 m² is all
interior floor. 2 — the two front doors are 1 m out of line, and the only route between the
apartments is out one, across the hall and in the other. 12 rooms, 218.40 m², and `arch lint`
